evidence.detail: 100-card singleton detection treats entire deck as maindeck, but never identifies which card is the commander — sideboard is cleared rather than preserving the commander
insert_deck_card uses a boolean sideboard column; no commander-specific column or flag exists in the schema
No goldfish commander deck scraper exists anywhere in the codebase
Confirms commanders appear as sideboard cards in the downloaded decklist, validating the bug report

triage.notes: Two separate sub-problems: (1) scraping the commander identity from mtggoldfish commander deck URLs, and (2) either repurposing deck_card.sideboard or adding a new 'is_commander' column. The title itself offers both options but neither is small — any schema change is a migration and the scraping needs web-fetching logic.
